limitations: Local controls are not independent terrain truth. Nearest controls are selected greedily without replacement, not matched for terrain slope or land cover.

Ratios compare center P95 with the maximum P95 at offsets of at least 5 m using identical crossing rows. Summary ratios require >=20 joint rows and >=80% central support; thresholds are descriptive only.
A localized signal does not establish source artifact or natural origin. No raster is modified.
